heading: President's Message
body_html:
AS METRO TEKNİK LTD. ŞTİ, WE SEEK TO COMPLETELY REFLECT THE ARCHITECTURAL AND ENGINEERING NORMS THAT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF THE MODERN ERA THAT ARE OPEN TO INNOVATIONS BY USING THE RECENT TECHNOLOGICAL DEVELOPMENTS IN AIR-CONDITIONING AND MECHANICAL INSTALLATION PROJECTS FOR ARCHITECTURAL PROJECTS THAT ARE DESIGNED IN A HIGH QUALITY.

OUR COMPANY HAS CONTRIBUTED TO THE ECONOMY SIGNIFICANTLY WITH THE PROJECTS IN THE REPUBLIC OF TURKEY, TURKIC REPUBLICS, RUSSIA AND MIDDLE EAST COUNTRIES. IN ADDITION TO INCREASING THE ECONOMIC STRENGTH AND PROSPERITY OF OUR COUNTRY, WE HAVE A STRUCTURE THAT RECREATES NEW LINES OF BUSINESSES AND GROWS EVERY DAY IN THE FIELD OF EMPLOYMENT AND STAFF.

BY PUSHING THE PRINCIPLE OF PROFITABILITY-MAIN RULE OF TRADING- INTO THE BACKGROUND IN OUR PROJECTS, WE ATTACH IMPORTANCE TO THE SAFETY OF LIFE AND PROPERTY AS WELL AS PROVIDING AFFORDABLE AND USEABLE PRODUCTS.

PROVIDING SERVICE, QUALITY AND TECHNOLOGICAL FACILITIES ALL TOGETHER, OUR COMPANY TAKES PRIDE IN THE MECHANICAL AND AIR-CONDITIONING PROJECTS THAT WE CARRY OUT WITH OUR SOLUTION-ORIENTED, YOUNG AND EXPERIENCED STAFF. WE ARE A BIG, STRONG AND SUCCESSFUL FAMILY BRINGING THE PAST SUCCESS TOGETHER WITH FUTURE’S OPPORTUNITIES.

HÜSEYİN TÜRKAN
CHAIRMAN OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS
